function automatic logic [NUM_OF_CLIENTS-1:0] rr_expected_grant(
    input logic [NUM_OF_CLIENTS-1:0] req,
    input logic [NUM_OF_CLIENTS-1:0] last
);
  logic [NUM_OF_CLIENTS-1:0] high_req, low_req, high_mask, low_mask;
  if (last == '0) begin

    low_mask = '0;

    low_mask = last | (last - 1'b1);

  if (|high_req)
    return high_req & (~high_req + 1'b1);
  else
